user.title: Add a child
user.description: One Activity Tracker entry per child. Events are logged with button presses; counts, charts and feeding reminders are computed locally. No external services.

data_description.name: Display name used in entity names, the device and notifications. Any text, e.g. Robert.
data_description.prefix: Used in all entity IDs, e.g. button.rob_feeding. Leave empty to derive it from the name. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
data_description.feeding_interval_hours: Target hours between feedings (1-6, step 0.25). Editable later from the number entity or here.
data_description.notify_targets: Optional. Comma-separated notify entities notified when a feeding is overdue, e.g. notify.mobile_app_dad, notify.mobile_app_mom.

error.invalid_interval: The feeding interval must be between 1 and 6 hours.
error.invalid_targets: Notify targets must be comma-separated notify.* entity IDs.

abort.already_configured: A child with this prefix is already configured.

init.title: Edit child
init.description: Changing the name, prefix or notify targets reloads this child's entities. Changing the prefix changes all entity IDs (long-term statistics follow entity IDs); the feeding interval is applied live.
